title.en: Explain why it needs attention after 1991

say.en: Most Indians still live in villages, and a large part of them depend on farming. If the villages stay poor, India stays poor. So what does it take to develop a village? In this lesson: Define rural development.
List its key areas.
Explain why it needs attention after 1991.

body.en: Rural development is action for the development of *areas* that are lagging behind in the overall development of the village economy. Its key areas are: development of human resources (literacy, especially female literacy, education, skills, health and sanitation); land reforms; development of the productive resources of each locality; infrastructure (electricity, irrigation, credit, marketing, transport, agricultural research and extension, information); and special measures to reduce poverty and improve the living conditions of weaker sections.
body.kn: ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳನ್ನು ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಪಡಿಸುವ ಕ್ರಮವೇ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ, ಭೂ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ, ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಉತ್ಪಾದಕ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳು, ವಿದ್ಯುತ್, ನೀರಾವರಿ, ಸಾಲ, ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ, ರಸ್ತೆಗಳಂತಹ ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಬಡತನ ನಿವಾರಣೆ ಸೇರಿವೆ.

narration.en: A household earning ₹100 thousand a year mostly from farming is hit hard when the rains fail. Rural development aims to add non-farm work (dairy, poultry, small industry, services) so that one bad season does not ruin the family. steps.en: Low female literacy: development of human resources.
Borrowing from a moneylender: infrastructure (institutional credit).
No work after kharif: productive employment through diversification and poverty alleviation measures.

say.en: Key areas: human resources, land reforms, productive resources, infrastructure, poverty alleviation.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳು: ಮಾನವ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ, ಭೂ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ, ಉತ್ಪಾದಕ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ, ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯ, ಬಡತನ ನಿವಾರಣೆ.

say.en: Public investment in agriculture fell after 1991.
say.kn: 1991 ರ ನಂತರ ಕೃಷಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಕುಸಿಯಿತು.

say.en: Villages need non-farm jobs and better infrastructure.
say.kn: ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೃಷಿಯೇತರ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ತಮ ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯ ಬೇಕು.

say.en: Next: Rural credit.
